name: claude-plugin-to-opencode
description: Port a Claude Code plugin to OpenCode, as a plugin: skills with rewritten path anchors and host-valid names, a generated OpenCode plugin that runs the PreToolUse hooks and carries the MCP servers and permission rules, rules file. Installs under ~/.config/opencode, or builds a portable bundle that installs by unzipping. The OpenCode command of the claude-plugin-port engine.
author: Flavien Chervet
